library_preparation_preflight.summary: org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial:8.0.0.Beta1 is a Maven relocation POM to org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-spatial; combined with the hibernate-platform BOM's dual-coordinate constraints, depending on the old org.hibernate coordinate causes an unresolvable Gradle capability/version-constraint conflict, not a real compile error.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: For this version, change the generated build.gradle test dependency from `testImplementation "org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial:$libraryVersion"` to `testImplementation "org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-spatial:$libraryVersion"`. Do not add the org.hibernate.orm coordinate alongside the old org.hibernate one — keeping both present still fails resolution, since org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial is a Gradle-metadata relocation whose target reimports a platform BOM that redeclares both coordinates, producing a version-constraint cycle. Existing test code (SpatialInitializer, StandardServiceRegistryBuilder) is unchanged in the relocated artifact and needs no source changes.
risks: If a future patch of hibernate-spatial 8.x un-relocates or changes the platform BOM's constraint shape, this workaround may no longer be needed or may need adjusting.
